title: Sunset SUP Yoga Class in Virginia Beach
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience a unique blend of Stand Up Paddleboarding and yoga during a sunset session on the calm waters of Virginia Beach. Designed for all levels, this guided class combines gentle movement, balance, and mindfulness in a peaceful outdoor setting. Whether you are new to paddleboarding or an experienced yogi, your instructor provides step-by-step guidance to help you build confidence on the board while enjoying the colors of the evening sky. This relaxing workshop offers an opportunity to connect with nature, improve focus, and experience yoga from a fresh perspective on the water.
